newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Old crop soybean offers raised.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Old crop soybean offers raised.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf old crop soybean basis offers were higher on Monday amid talk that the recent sharp setback in prices had left U.S. supplies competitive to some destinations in the export market.

Dealers noted that South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp (AFMC) announced it was tendering on July 15 to buy 40,000 tonnes of soybeans for July 26-September 15 shipment if from the U.S. Gulf.
Wheat basis offers were steady amid talk that the recent drop in prices to three-year lows may spark renewed buying interest, possibly from Morocco and Egypt.
